# Swop

> Swop is a self-custodial crypto wallet and social trading app on Solana, Ethereum,
> Base, and Polygon. It combines a gas-sponsored wallet (no SOL or ETH needed for
> fees), token swaps, perpetual futures, prediction markets, in-person crypto
> payments (SwopPay, 0.5% checkout fee), and an AI trading agent that proposes
> trades but never signs without user approval. Keys stay on the user's device.

## Key pages
- [Swop home](https://www.swopme.co): product overview
- [Web app](https://swopme.app): the Swop wallet in the browser
- [Blog](https://www.swopme.co/blog): Swop Journal — product, markets, engineering
- [Solana wallet with a built-in swap](https://www.swopme.co/blog/solana-wallet-with-built-in-swap): what it means for a wallet to swap tokens without leaving the app, how an in-wallet swap actually works on-chain, and what to check before trusting one
- [Tokenizing real-world assets](https://www.swopme.co/blog/tokenized-real-world-assets): how RWA tokens are actually backed — Ondo's Treasuries and equities, Paxos's allocated gold, and a luxury-brand provenance consortium — and why a token is only as good as its redemption right
- [AI agents and your wallet: a safety checklist](https://www.swopme.co/blog/ai-agent-wallet-safety-checklist): the five mechanisms — self-custody, confirmation before signing, bounded agent authority, an audit trail, and an always-open exit — that determine whether a wallet lets an AI agent trade for you safely
- [ERC-8196 agent policy](https://www.swopme.co/blog/erc-8196-agent-policy): how a versioned, signature-gated policy layer bounds what an AI trading agent may do, and what a hash-chained audit log does and does not prove
- [What is x402?](https://www.swopme.co/blog/what-is-x402): the HTTP 402 payment protocol that lets an AI agent pay for a request in one round trip
- [Crypto tap to pay](https://www.swopme.co/blog/crypto-tap-to-pay): how in-person contactless crypto payments work and what settles on-chain
- [Self-custody wallets and Bangladesh law](https://www.swopme.co/blog/self-custody-wallet-bangladesh): what self-custody does and does not change legally — Bangladesh Bank's stated position that crypto trading is not permitted, and why holding your own keys is not a workaround
- [The next account primitive](https://www.swopme.co/blog/accept-card-payments-merchant-verification): why email made accounts universal but left them inert, what a transactional identity adds, and why proving one fact without disclosing the rest (ZeroProof) is the load-bearing piece
- [The CLARITY Act vote](https://www.swopme.co/blog/clarity-act-vote-explained): why the Senate cloture vote failed 49-50, what the SEC and CFTC are building instead through rulemaking, and why a rule is not a law for capital formation, for where builders incorporate, or for the durability of self-custody
- [Cross-chain swap wallet](https://www.swopme.co/blog/cross-chain-swap-wallet): how a swap between two blockchains is really assembled — lock-and-mint bridges, liquidity networks and aggregated routes, and where the risk concentrates
- [Send crypto with a link](https://www.swopme.co/blog/send-crypto-with-a-link): how claim-link transfers work — funding a link instead of an address, what happens if nobody claims it, and why the link is a bearer instrument
- [What is a SmartSite?](https://www.swopme.co/blog/what-is-a-smartsite): what a SmartSite (crypto profile page) is — tabbed sections, gated content, and taking payment on the page itself
- [Crypto link in bio](https://www.swopme.co/blog/crypto-link-in-bio): what a crypto link-in-bio storefront is, and how AI agents can buy from one over x402
- [Agentic trading launch](https://www.swopme.co/blog/agentic-trading-is-live): how Swop's AI agent and its confirmation model work
- [Prediction markets, explained](https://www.swopme.co/blog/prediction-markets-101): how prediction-market prices become probabilities, and how to read the order book behind them
- [Perpetual futures funding rate, explained](https://www.swopme.co/blog/perps-funding-rate-explained): what a funding rate is, how the payment direction between longs and shorts is decided, and how to read it before opening a position
- [Self-custody wallet, explained](https://www.swopme.co/blog/self-custody-wallet-solana): what self-custody means on Solana and what to check before choosing a wallet
- [Gasless crypto, explained](https://www.swopme.co/blog/gasless-crypto-wallet): how sponsored-transaction ("gasless") wallets actually work, and what to check before trusting one
- [Is Swop safe?](https://www.swopme.co/blog/is-swop-safe): who holds the keys, what requires your signature, and what Swop's AI agent can and can't do without you
- [Swop vs Phantom](https://www.swopme.co/blog/swop-vs-phantom): a neutral feature comparison — custody, chains, gas fees, in-person payments, and AI agent design
- [Swop vs Coinbase Wallet](https://www.swopme.co/blog/swop-vs-coinbase-wallet): a neutral feature comparison — custody, chains, gas fees, and in-person payments
- [USDC vs USDC.e vs pUSD](https://www.swopme.co/blog/usdc-vs-usdce): what the naming means — Circle-issued vs bridge-issued vs venue-issued dollar tokens, and why the difference matters.
- [Support](https://support.swop.id): help and documentation
- [About](https://www.swopme.co/about.html): company and team
